mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO material_processing_usage ( content_blob_id, owner_key, version_id, first_revision_id, page_count ) SELECT v.content_blob_id, v.owner_key, v.id, r.id, v.page_count FROM material_processing_revision r JOIN material_version v ON v.id = r.version_id WHERE r.id = #{revisionId} AND (r.state IN ('READY', 'PARTIAL_READY') OR (r.state = 'PROCESSING' AND r.stage IN ('INDEXING', 'PUBLISHING') AND r.progress >= 93)) AND v.page_count IS NOT NULL
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM material_processing_job j JOIN material_processing_revision r ON r.id = j.revision_id JOIN material_version v ON v.id = r.version_id JOIN material m ON m.id = v.material_id JOIN retrieval_revision_vector_projection rv ON rv.revision_id = r.id AND rv.index_generation_id = #{generationId} AND rv.projection_role = 'COMPATIBILITY' JOIN rag_index_generation g ON g.id = rv.index_generation_id JOIN rag_index_generation_target target ON target.revision_id = r.id AND target.index_generation_id = g.id WHERE r.id = #{revisionId} AND (r.state IN ('READY', 'PARTIAL_READY') OR (r.state = 'PROCESSING' AND r.stage IN ('INDEXING', 'PUBLISHING') AND r.progress >= 93)) AND g.state IN ('BUILDING', 'SHADOW', 'ACTIVE') AND target.state IN ('PENDING', 'PLANNED') AND m.lifecycle_state = 'ACTIVE' AND (m.retention_class = 'RETAINED' OR m.expires_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) AND j.id = #{jobId} AND j.stage = #{stage} AND j.status = 'RUNNING' AND j.lease_owner = #{workerId} AND j.fence_token = #{fenceToken} AND j.lease_until > UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)

mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO rag_index_generation_target ( index_generation_id, revision_id, tokenizer_fingerprint, state, required_at ) SELECT #{generationId}, required_revision.revision_id, #{tokenizerFingerprint}, 'PENDING', #{requiredAt} FROM ( SELECT active_version.active_revision_id AS revision_id FROM material_version active_version WHERE active_version.active_revision_id IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT source_pin.processing_revision_id AS revision_id FROM diagram_source_pin source_pin UNION SELECT citation.revision_id FROM citation_evidence citation UNION SELECT in_flight.id FROM material_processing_revision in_flight JOIN material_revision_artifact retrieval_manifest ON retrieval_manifest.revision_id = in_flight.id AND retrieval_manifest.artifact_kind = 'RETRIEVAL_MANIFEST' WHERE in_flight.state = 'PROCESSING' AND in_flight.stage IN ('INDEXING', 'PUBLISHING') AND in_flight.progress >= 93 ) required_revision JOIN material_processing_revision r ON r.id = required_revision.revision_id AND (r.state IN ('READY', 'PARTIAL_READY') OR (r.state = 'PROCESSING' AND r.stage IN ('INDEXING', 'PUBLISHING') AND r.progress >= 93)) JOIN material_version v ON v.id = r.version_id JOIN material m ON m.id = v.material_id AND m.lifecycle_state = 'ACTIVE' AND m.retention_class = 'RETAINED' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM material_scope_link durable_scope WHERE durable_scope.material_id = m.id AND durable_scope.scope_type IN ('LIBRARY', 'DIAGRAM', 'CHARTBOOK')) WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM retrieval_revision_vector_projection existing_projection WHERE existing_projection.revision_id = r.id AND existing_projection.index_generation_id = #{generationId} AND NOT (existing_projection.projection_role = 'PRIMARY' AND existing_projection.expected_projection_count = 0 AND existing_projection.state = 'READY') )
mapper.select: SELECT , g.id AS index_generation_id, g.index_name, g.namespace, g.embedding_model, g.embedding_model_fingerprint, g.dimension, g.metric, g.vector_schema_version, target.tokenizer_fingerprint FROM rag_index_generation_target target JOIN rag_index_generation g ON g.id = target.index_generation_id JOIN material_processing_revision r ON r.id = target.revision_id JOIN material_version v ON v.id = r.version_id JOIN material m ON m.id = v.material_id JOIN material_revision_artifact manifest ON manifest.revision_id = r.id AND manifest.artifact_kind = 'RETRIEVAL_MANIFEST' WHERE target.index_generation_id = #{generationId} AND target.state = 'PENDING' AND g.state IN ('BUILDING', 'SHADOW', 'ACTIVE') AND (r.state IN ('READY', 'PARTIAL_READY') OR (r.state = 'PROCESSING' AND r.stage IN ('INDEXING', 'PUBLISHING') AND r.progress >= 93)) AND m.lifecycle_state = 'ACTIVE' AND (m.retention_class = 'RETAINED' OR m.expires_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) ORDER BY target.required_at, target.revision_id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT r.id AS revision_id, pm.content_sha256 AS projection_manifest_sha256, pm.manifest_hash AS projection_manifest_hash FROM rag_index_generation_target target JOIN material_processing_revision r ON r.id = target.revision_id JOIN retrieval_revision_vector_projection rv ON rv.revision_id = r.id AND rv.index_generation_id = target.index_generation_id AND rv.state = 'READY' JOIN retrieval_projection_manifest pm ON pm.revision_id = r.id AND pm.index_generation_id = target.index_generation_id AND pm.state = 'READY' JOIN rag_index_generation g ON g.id = target.index_generation_id AND g.state = 'ACTIVE' WHERE target.index_generation_id = #{generationId} AND target.state = 'READY' AND r.state = 'PROCESSING' AND r.stage = 'PUBLISHING' AND r.progress = 98 ORDER BY r.id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT g.id AS generation_id, g.state AS generation_state, (SELECT active.id FROM rag_index_generation active WHERE active.state = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY active.activated_at, active.id LIMIT 1) AS active_generation_id, COALESCE(profile.target_generation, 0) AS target_generation, COUNT(target.revision_id) AS required_revision_count, COALESCE(SUM(target.state = 'READY'), 0) AS ready_revision_count, COALESCE(SUM(rv.expected_projection_count), 0) AS expected_vector_count, COALESCE(SUM((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM retrieval_chunk_vector_projection indexed JOIN retrieval_chunk chunk ON chunk.id = indexed.retrieval_chunk_id WHERE chunk.revision_id = target.revision_id AND indexed.index_generation_id = g.id AND indexed.state = 'INDEXED')), 0) AS indexed_vector_count, COALESCE(SUM(manifest.state = 'READY'), 0) AS ready_manifest_count FROM rag_index_generation g LEFT JOIN rag_index_generation_target target ON target.index_generation_id = g.id LEFT JOIN rag_index_generation_compatibility_profile profile ON profile.index_generation_id = g.id LEFT JOIN retrieval_revision_vector_projection rv ON rv.revision_id = target.revision_id AND rv.index_generation_id = g.id LEFT JOIN retrieval_projection_manifest manifest ON manifest.revision_id = target.revision_id AND manifest.index_generation_id = g.id WHERE g.id = #{generationId} GROUP BY g.id, g.state, profile.target_generation
